description: Defines the Supervisor Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for the HRM system, responsible for normalizing supervisor data related to employees, including supervisor's name and reporting method.

classes.name: Supervisor
classes.description: A DTO representing supervisor data for a given employee, capable of normalizing supervisor info including name and reporting method.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Supervisor DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts supervisor data into an array based on specified fields, fetching supervisor entities.

methods.name: callGetterOnItem
methods.description: Retrieves specific data for a supervisor entity, including special handling for reporting method.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Defines the mapping of field names to getter methods for supervisor data.
